# Navigation rail (`nav-rail`)

Side navigation with icons, labels and badges.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createNavRail` (types in `dist/web/navigation/navRail.d.ts`): `nav.mh-nav-rail` (`--expanded`, `--labels-selected | --labels-none`): an optional `__header`, then`ul.mh-nav-rail__list` (and a `--footer` list) of `a | button.mh-nav-rail__item` (`aria-current="page"` on theselected one). Each item has an `__indicator` pill around the icon with an optional `__badge` (`--dot`), and a`__label`. Native links and buttons, so Tab and Enter work as everywhere else.

```ts
export function createNavRail(options: NavRailOptions): NavRailHandle;

export interface NavRailOptions {
  items: readonly NavRailItem[];
  /** Items pinned to the bottom (settings, profile). */
  footerItems?: readonly NavRailItem[];
  /** Selected id. */
  value?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the navigation; default "Main". */
  label?: string;
  /** Labels beside the icons in a wider rail, instead of under them. */
  expanded?: boolean;
  /** `all` (default) shows every label; `selected` only the current one's; `none` hides them (still read out). */
  labels?: 'all' | 'selected' | 'none';
  /** Content above the items: a menu button, a primary action. */
  header?: Child | Child[];
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface NavRailHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  value(): string;
  setValue(id: string): void;
  setBadge(id: string, badge: NavRailBadge | null): void;
  setExpanded(expanded: boolean): void;
}

export interface NavRailItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Icon while selected (a filled variant). */
  iconSelected?: IconName | string;
  badge?: NavRailBadge | null;
  /** Spoken with the badge ("3 unread"); default the count, or "new" for a dot. */
  badgeLabel?: string;
  href?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createNavRail } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rail = createNavRail({
  label: 'Main',
  value: 'home',
  items: [
    { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
    { id: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb', iconSelected: 'lightbulb-on' },
    { id: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: 'music' },
    { id: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts', icon: 'bell', badge: 3, badgeLabel: '3 unread' },
  ],
  footerItems: [{ id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' }],
  onChange: (id) => {
    // Opening the alerts marks them read.
    if (id === 'alerts') rail.setBadge('alerts', null);
  },
});

document.body.append(rail.el);
```

## React API

`NavRail` (types in `dist/react/navigation.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createNavRail`; controlled through `value` / `onChange`.

```ts
export function NavRail({ items, footerItems, value = '', onChange, label = 'Main', expanded, labels = 'all', header, className }: NavRailProps);

export interface NavRailProps {
  items: readonly NavRailItem[];
  footerItems?: readonly NavRailItem[];
  /** Controlled: the selected id. */
  value?: string;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  label?: string;
  expanded?: boolean;
  labels?: 'all' | 'selected' | 'none';
  header?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { NavRail } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const SETTINGS = [{ id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' }];

export function NavRailExample() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('home');
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(3);
  const open = (id: string) => {
    setPage(id);
    if (id === 'alerts') setUnread(0);
  };
  const items = [
    { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
    { id: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb', iconSelected: 'lightbulb-on' },
    { id: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: 'music' },
    { id: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts', icon: 'bell', badge: unread || null, badgeLabel: `${unread} unread` },
  ];
  return <NavRail label="Main" items={items} footerItems={SETTINGS} value={page} onChange={open} />;
}
```
